enabled.description: Whether new contacts enroll. Running enrollments go on either way.

oneOf.description: Enrollments by status; only when getting one sequence.

list_id.description: The list whose contacts it mails.

body_md.description: The body in Markdown. `{{ name }}` and `{{ email }}` are filled in.

delay_hours.description: Hours to wait after enrolling (first step) or after the step before.

id.description: The step ID. Edits keep it, so a contact never gets a step twice.

position.description: Its place in the sequence, from 0.

SequenceTrigger.description: What enrolls contacts in a sequence.

start.description: When the hour or day starts.

anon_id.description: The anonymous ID the snippet stored, to link browser events.

name.description:
A custom event name (1-64 letters, digits, or `_ . : -`),
`pageview`, or `$identify` to record traits and link `anon_id` to
`user_id`.

props.description:
Event properties: at most 20, with string (256 characters), number
or boolean values.

traits.description: User traits, for `$identify` only. Same limits as `props`.

url.description: The page the event relates to; its path and UTM tags are kept.

user_id.description:
Your ID for the user. Needed for `$identify`; one of `user_id` and
`anon_id` is needed for every event.

email.description: The email to send the link to.

next.description: A path in the app to return to after signing in, such as `/invite/...`.

Site.description: A project's analytics settings and snippet.

has_events.description: Whether any event has arrived yet.

hostnames.description:
Hostnames the snippet may send from, exact or `*.example.com`. Empty
means any host.

identity_mode.description: What the snippet may store in a visitor's browser.

key.description: The public key in the snippet tag.

snippet.description: The `<script>` tag to add to every page.

kind.description: A pageview or a custom event.

match.description: A page path (exact, or a prefix ending in `*`) or an event name.

StepInput.description: A step of a sequence being saved.

delay_hours.description:
Hours to wait after enrolling (first step) or after the step before,
0 to 8760.

oneOf.description: The step's ID, to keep an existing step; absent adds a new one.

from_first.description: Share of the first step's people, 0 to 1.

from_previous.description: Share of the previous step's people, 0 to 1; 1 for the first step.

Submission.description: What someone sent through a form.

referer.description: The page that sent it (`Referer`), at most 512 characters.

spam_reason.description: Why the bot check flagged it, if it did.

csv.description: The CSV text: a header row, then one row per submission, newest first.

truncated.description: True when more submissions exist than the export holds.

SubmissionList.description: A page of submissions, newest first.

oneOf.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last page.

interval.description:
What one chart point covers: hours for a one-day range, else days.
A one-day range past raw retention has one daily point.

oneOf.description: Counts for the previous period of the same length, when asked.

previous_series.description: The same for the previous period, when asked.

series.description: Visitors and pageviews over the range, one point per interval.

Suppression.description: An address no list in the workspace mails.

oneOf.description: The delivery that bounced or drew the complaint.

note.description: A team member's note, for manual entries.

SuppressionPage.description: A page of suppressions, by address.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; absent on the last one.

id.description: The entity ID, as `target_ids` takes it.

TargetList.description: A project's entities of one kind.

TestCase.description: A saved input to run a script on, and what it must return.

name.description: A name, unique in the script.

items.description: One result per case, in case order.

run.description: The recorded run, with what the script returned and logged.

Totals.description:
Counts over a date range. Visitors are summed over days, because the
visitor hash changes every day.

conversions.description:
Goal conversions: unique visitors per day who reached a goal, over
every goal.

VerifyBody.description: Exchange a sign-in link's token for a session.

token.description: The `token` query parameter of the link.

Workspace.description: A workspace, the unit of tenancy.

slug.description: The URL-safe name, unique on the instance and immutable.

WorkspaceRef.description: A workspace's ID, slug and name.
